parsed.post: Huge breakthrough! Reduced val_bpb from 1.015 to 1.001 by halving the batch size to 262144. This allowed for more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try to further refine the learning rate or increase DEPTH to 8 to see if capacity/steps balance can be improved further.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to maximize optimizer steps and capacity within the 5-minute budget.
